intel_items.topic: Massachusetts towns update ADU zoning (5 towns, all positive)
intel_items.why_it_matters: Direct lead generation opportunity in 5 towns with newly favorable zoning. Could generate 15-20 leads per town within 60-90 days post-approval.
facts: Newton voted to allow ADUs on 50%+ of residential lots
Wellesley, Arlington, Lexington all passed positive ADU amendments (Feb-Mar 2026)
Public hearings scheduled in Brookline and Cambridge for April
inferences: Homeowners in these 5 towns will start feasibility inquiries within 30-60 days
MassDwell should position as local expert before competitors do
Municipal partnerships possible (towns may need local provider lists)

recommendation.default: Launch targeted outreach campaign to 5 towns (Framingham, Newton, Wellesley, Arlington, Lexington). Create town-specific landing pages + municipal partnership proposal. Deadline: 3/15 to be first-mover.
recommendation.alternative: Wait for demand to naturally spike, then launch reactive campaign in May

next_actions.title: Create town-specific landing pages (5 towns) + FAQ
next_actions.notes: Include zoning summary (non-legal), feasibility CTA, local testimonials

next_actions.title: Draft municipal partnership proposal + outreach list
next_actions.notes: Target: planning directors, town admins, board of selectmen

intel_items.topic: Competitor price cut 15% on MA1-equivalent machine
intel_items.why_it_matters: Direct pricing pressure on Atlantic Laser margins. Competitor moved from $7.2K to $6.1K. Could impact sales velocity and profitability if not countered.
facts: Primary arc welder competitor reduced price 15% ($7.2K → $6.1K)
inferences: Competitor may be trying to gain market share or clear inventory
Atlantic Laser's speed/efficiency ROI becomes more important for differentiation
Customer objection handling needs to shift to value (ROI, training, support)

recommendation.default: Create ROI-focused positioning materials (speed, efficiency, total cost of ownership). Consider bundled packages (machine + training + 1-year support) at current price. Document margin impact with Finance.
recommendation.alternative: Match price, absorb margin reduction, and differentiate on service/support

next_actions.title: Analyze Atlantic Laser margin impact of competitor cut
next_actions.notes: Calculate break-even volume, sensitivity analysis on 5-10% price cuts

next_actions.title: Draft ROI value prop messaging + counter-positioning
next_actions.notes: Focus: 4x faster = less downtime, 80% less energy = lower operating costs

intel_items.topic: 3 new ADU competitors entered MA market Q1 2026
intel_items.why_it_matters: Market competition increasing. New entrants pricing $165K-$195K (near MassDwell range). Need to monitor positioning, lead magnets, customer acquisition tactics.
facts: Competitor A: pricing $165K-$185K, targeting Boston-area homeowners
Competitor B: pricing $175K-$195K, emphasizing design customization
Competitor C: pricing $155K-$175K, focus on fast permits (claimed 6-week timeline)
inferences: Market competition is normalizing (more players = more demand signals)
MassDwell's timeline (8-12 weeks) is still competitive vs Competitor C's claims
Design customization and permitting speed are becoming table-stakes for messaging

recommendation.default: Monitor competitor lead magnets, messaging, and customer reviews monthly. Maintain messaging focus on MassDwell's timeline certainty (8-12 weeks post-approval) and proven execution.
recommendation.alternative: Initiate competitive price positioning study + customer survey on decision drivers

next_actions.title: Create monthly competitor tracking dashboard
next_actions.notes: Monitor: pricing, messaging, lead magnets, customer testimonials, social media activity
